messages.subject: Sampling with plyr
parts:
Hello,

I would like to split my dataframe (by a variable) into a list and then select a random sample from each list element.

I've got the split working, but I can't figure out how to give sample the appropriate arguments, i.e.

> data2<-dlply(data,.(type2),sample(data2,10)  #split by type and select 10 rows from each list element

doesn't work.

Any pointers on this kind of sampling from lists would be much appreciated.

Many thanks,

Mark
